STATEMENT OF WORK 1.0 Introduction/Background North Texas VA Police officers are required to qualify on their assigned weapons on a quarterly basis. Overtime discharge of spent ammunition leads to accumulation of lead and other hazardous materials on range surfaces. Regular maintenance of the mobile firing range is essential to ensure safety and longevity of the equipment. Routine cleaning reduces exposure to hazardous materials such as lead dust, mitigates fire hazards, and ensures compliance with VA safety regulations. Failure to conduct regular maintenance could result in increased health risks, costly repairs, and possible suspension of range operations.
